3 دامجهُ , (A, L,) inf. n. دِمَاجٌ, (L,) (tropical:) He agreed with him, [and he aided him, (see 6,)] عَلَيْهِ [against him, or respecting it, or to do it]. (L, A.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) [He soothed, coaxed, wheedled, or cajoled, him, as though concealing enmity: for its inf. n.] مُدَامَجَةٌ is like مُدَاجَاةٌ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
